name: Multi-resolution Triangle Texture
aliases: Learnable Feature Vectors at Vertices of Recursively Subdivided Triangle Grid
definition: A parameterization of per-triangle textures using learnable feature vectors at vertices of a recursively subdivided triangle grid, supporting multi-resolution optimization without a 2D texture atlas.
summary: Multi-resolution Triangle Texture uses learnable vertex features on subdivided grids for stable training, storing only the finest resolution at runtime.
